info.name: AWS DR demo API
info.description: Requests and tests for the AWS DR demo API (banking ledger on an Aurora Global Database, two regions). Set the environment variables baseUrl (https://<api domain>, no trailing slash) and cognito_id_token (secret, a Cognito ID token of a demo user). Every application response carries X-Served-By-Region. Amounts and balances are strings with two decimals. Run folders 01 to 03 in order for functional checks (02 starts with a deposit that later requests rely on) and folder 04 during the DR drill.

exec: pm.test("Body has status ok and a region", function () {
pm.test("Shallow health does not touch the database", function () {

request.description: Liveness of the Lambda in whichever region Route 53 currently selects. Does not touch the database. Use it first in the drill to confirm the API answers.

exec: pm.test("Body has status, region and database_role", function () {

request.description: Also checks the database and returns its role (writer or read-only replica). Use it before the drill (pre-checks) and after the promotion to confirm the new writer.

exec: pm.test("Body is the API Gateway authorizer rejection, not an application response", function () {

request.description: Calls GET /account without the Authorization header. The Cognito authorizer rejects it with 401 before any Lambda runs, so the response has no X-Served-By-Region header and no account data.

pm.test("Same transaction id as the original request", function () {

request.description: Sends the same Idempotency-Key and body as the last 'Create deposit'. Expects 200 with the original transaction id and balance (no second movement). Do not regenerate the key between the two requests.

exec: pm.test("Transaction is a withdrawal of 1.00", function () {
pm.test("Balance dropped by exactly the amount withdrawn", function () {

request.description: Withdraws 1.00 with a fresh Idempotency-Key. Run it after 'Create deposit' (which leaves at least 1.00 in the account). Expects 201, type withdrawal and a balance 1.00 lower than before.

exec: pm.test("Response has a transaction id and a balance", function () {

request.description: Deposits without an Idempotency-Key header. Expects 201 (the request is not protected against a retry).

exec: pm.test("error.code is insufficient_funds and error.balance is the current balance", function () {

request.description: Withdraws 9999999999.99 (the maximum amount), which is above any balance the demo can reach. Expects 422 insufficient_funds with the current balance, saved in overdraftBalance. The next request, 'Overdraft: balance is unchanged', checks the account.

exec: pm.test("Balance equals the balance reported by the rejected withdrawal", function () {
pm.expect(before, "run 'Overdraft: withdrawal above the balance' first").to.be.a("string").and.not.empty;

request.description: Run right after 'Overdraft: withdrawal above the balance'. The balance must equal the one saved from the 422 response: the rejected withdrawal changed nothing.
type must be deposit or withdrawal. Expects 400 validation_error and an error.fields entry for 'type'.
Amounts allow at most two decimals. Expects 400 validation_error and an error.fields entry for 'amount'.
A negative amount must be rejected with 400 validation_error and error.fields naming 'amount'.
Unknown properties are rejected. Expects 400 and a field error naming the unknown field 'note'.

limit must be an integer between 1 and 100. Expects 400 validation_error naming 'limit'.
